text: What if you folded this piece of paper...
and it grows taller than the tallest building we've ever built.
A few folds later, it climbs into space...
and passes Voyager One, the farthest thing humanity ever launched.
Just past one hundred folds, the paper grows bigger than the observable universe.
One student needed over a kilometer of tissue.
One thousand folds, and the height is ten to the power of 281 light-years - nothing in the universe comes close.
One sheet of paper, one thousand folds...
and the universe comes up short.
